candidate.name: archaeopteryx-js
candidate.notes: Full viewer application driven imperatively (launch/destroy); d3 7.9.0 and phyloxml 1.1.7 put on globalThis for the UMD file; panel collapsed by default.

tipClick.how: the library has no click callback: the adapter listens for DOM clicks on the container and maps them to a node (the d3 datum of a clicked label, else layout coordinates within 5 units); events are source adapter-derived and the library still opens its own node menu

internalNodeClick.how: same workaround; internal nodes have no DOM element, so they are found from the library's (undocumented) node coordinates; in the circular layout the polar mapping is re-derived from the labelled nodes; after the node menu's Reroot a node may no longer be a clade of the shared tree, and then no event is reported

branchClick.how: no branch elements (branches are batched into one path per style); a click near a branch resolves to the nearest node, never to a branch

hover.how: the library shows its own tooltip and has no callback; the adapter derives tipHover/nodeHover from a throttled mousemove hit test (adapter-derived)

descendantTipsInPayload.how: the library emits no payload at all (the selection event is payload-less); tip sets come from the shared TreeModel through the adapter's node mapping (source adapter-derived)

cladeColouring.how: writes the phyloXML node.color on every node of the clade in the library's live tree object, then forces a redraw with the PageUp/PageDown font-size keys (applyViewState would reset zoom); no colour-a-clade API; an active search dims coloured clades too

highlightTip.how: search box A through applyViewState({searchA: regex on Node Name}); hits get bold label, halo and dot, everything else fades; resets zoom and pan; no per-tip style API

focusTip.how: search A (highlighted tips + this tip), then the documented Ctrl+G (centres the hit) and Ctrl+Shift+ArrowUp zoom keys dispatched on document; there is no focus/zoom-to API; the tip stays highlighted; rows are made readable up to 12,000 tips (every readable zoom draws a label element per tip)

tipAsLink.how: tip labels are SVG <text>; the adapter overlays <a href data-tip-id> on the visible labels (up to 400), repositioned by a MutationObserver after each redraw

customColumns.how: only built-ins: numeric columns become heat-map columns (2 or more needed: one bar column is drawn with a labelled mirror copy), text columns become label text and Color-by; no custom cell renderers

alignmentColumn.how: mol_seq on the tip nodes; the built-in alignment track (windowed 7 px columns, conservation bar or sequence logo, navigation bar fixed to the viewport)

radialLayout.how: layout: 'circular' through applyViewState (heat map as rings; alignment track rectangular only; 'unrooted' also exists but is not offered by the shell)

branchLengthToggle.how: applyViewState({display: 'phylogram' | 'cladogram'}); the library draws to scale only when more than half of the branches carry a positive length

scaleBar.how: a scale bar is drawn for phylograms; showScaleAxis adds a time or distance axis (checked on rich-corvoid-680)

darkTheme.how: the library's own light/dark switch (the adapter clicks its theme button; the choice is stored by the library in localStorage 'aptx-panel-theme'); dark palette is the library's, not GBIF's

cssTokens.how: no token contract: the adapter overrides default-coloured SVG attributes with CSS !important selectors (matching the library's fixed default colour values) and re-points the panel and menu --p-* custom properties

multipleInstances.how: module singleton: a second launch() empties the first container and it is not restored (verified: README says "One viewer per page")

cleanUnmount.how: viewer.destroy() removes the DOM, the body tooltip, the resize and the document key/wheel listeners (5 mount/unmount cycles: DOM node count and heap flat); it leaves one <style id="aptx-panel-styles"> and localStorage keys behind

controlledState.how: view state goes both ways (applyViewState / onViewChange: layout, display, tracks, collapsed clades, searches, colour-by); selection is read-only; no viewport, colour or highlight setters; every applyViewState resets zoom and pan

zoomToFit.how: fits on launch and on window resize (not on container resize: the adapter dispatches a window resize event); Ctrl+0 or the panel button refits

overviewOrMinimap.how: built-in overview miniature with a viewport rectangle (always shown: no config key switches it off)

caveat: Headless Chromium without a GPU (SwiftShader software rendering): absolute FPS for canvas and WebGL candidates is pessimistic; use for functional tests and relative comparison. Final scale numbers need a real browser on a normal laptop.
